01 — The Context

What founders typically face.

Early-stage founders are building product, brand, and traction at the same time with the same small team. Every piece of work competes with every other for the same hours.

Sequencing matters more than scope: an identity decided early, a landing page built around one action, an MVP that can survive its first real customers, and lead-generation automation once there is something to sell.
